The asset is in a brutal downtrend, sitting way below its 20-day SMA of 88.46 and 200-day SMA of 105.55, with an RSI-14 of 33.85 that still has room to plunge into oversold territory. Fundamentally, the stock is aggressively overvalued at a 143.12 P/E ratio despite contracting metrics, including a -33.48% YoY EPS growth and a dreadful -52.7% earnings miss last quarter. With spot uranium holding strong while mining shares sink, the market is aggressively disconnecting from equity value, making the short fade the absolute best-paying trade in this environment.

bear.last: CCJ: Shorting CCJ here at 81.47 is walking directly into a dangerous exhaustion trap right near its 52-week low of 77.57. With RSI-14 already sitting at an oversold 33.85 and the stock down -10.37% over the last 20 days, the absolute best part of the downside move has already been captured. Furthermore, spot uranium is holding strong while mining shares sink, creating a classic market disconnect that frequently snaps back violently when speculators least expect it. Shorting an asset this close to multi-month lows with a lofty 143.12 P/E ratio completely ignores the risk of a sharp mean-reversion bounce back toward the 20-day SMA of 88.46.
